request.subject: city
request.description: Style: bold chunky chibi game sprite, oversized head and oversized weapon, thick single-colour dark outline, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, big simple shapes that fill the canvas. Subject: one small fantasy town as a single strategy-game map piece: a compact cluster of four chunky cottages with bright red roofs huddled around one tall round stone keep tower with a big red banner flag on top, short stone ring wall in front, compact footprint, strong readable silhouette. Consistent strategy-game camera: three-quarter view looking slightly down, subject faces down-right (south-east), whole subject visible and centered on a transparent background, nothing cropped. Team colour: large solid bright red (#d8262c) areas are the maskable owner colour and must be clearly visible from a distance; no other red anywhere. The town fills almost the whole image edge to edge; no ground slab, grass square or base under it. Must not include: ground tile, grass, terrain, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, text, letters, numbers, UI, health bar, selection ring, frame, multiple units, crowd, cropped subject, blur, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, photorealism; thin outline, tiny details, gradients, noise.
